lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A spatial arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into approximately five vertical columns and four horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features running along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.
